name: ballerina/avro
description: Avro is an open-source data serialization system that enables efficient binary serialization and deserialization. It allows users to define schemas for structured data, providing better representation and fast serialization/deserialization. Avro's schema evolution capabilities ensure compatibility and flexibility in evolving data systems.

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description: Represents any error related to Ballerina Avro module

typeDefs.name: Schema
typeDefs.description:
Initializes the Avro schema with the given schema definition.

```ballerina
avro:Schema schema = check new(string `{"type": "int", "name" : "intValue", "namespace": "data" }`);
```

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Initializes the Avro schema with the given schema definition.

```ballerina
avro:Schema schema = check new(string `{"type": "int", "name" : "intValue", "namespace": "data" }`);
```

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: The Avro schema definition as a string

return.description: An `avro:Error` if the schema is not valid, otherwise nil

functions.name: toAvro

return.description: A `byte` array of the serialized data or else an `avro:Error`

functions.name: fromAvro

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The Avro serialized data to be deserialized

parameters.name: targetType
parameters.description: The type to be deserialized, inferred from the return type

return.description: A deserialized data for the given type or else an `avro:Error`
